headline: DONKEY KONG climbs the tower by himself
lede: WATCH batch 27 seats the construction site: press Y and Mario zigzags the girders under live barrels, waits at ladder mouths for a gap, and climbs the whole tower to Pauline without touching one. The engine was lifted whole-tick and determinised first — 24 seeded runs, all bank a lap, zero-touch proofs in the replay.

notes.text: sim.js whole-tick lift + seeded dice; the route driver scores 90-tick rollouts and learned arcade doctrine the hard way — jumps only against near barrels (a kangaroo could hop the tower, the original never did).

Unfroze main: the nightly soak roster had silently missed FROGGER and ASTEROIDS when contractGames grew (b25/b26) — the #1525 drift shape. Two-line fix on main, nightly re-proved green, and #2015 merged behind it.
kongcheck ships with the seat: 51 rules, byte-equal replays, and 17 mutants that all die.
Polish backlog filed for QA (#2018): the hammer the attract screen promises, the 25m rivet stage, and the oil-drum flame.

look.text: Press Y at the construction site and watch the proven climb
